body:
Can timeout and scheduling changes recover complete positive control pairs without repairing tasks? Follow-up to #28.

**Result so far:** all four previously incomplete Matchms exports (671, 675, 70, 98) now have verified positive control pairs: nop reward 0, oracle reward 1, all regression tests preserved, and four clean oracle commands. All 40 original task files are unchanged. Reconstruction plus eight controls consumed 0.431 allocated CPU-hours with zero model calls. These are completed controls for existing exports, not newly generated tasks.

**Limit:** the original image was deleted. We replayed its saved recipe unchanged except an ownership label, so mutable base/dependency drift remains. Original results are preserved separately; the new results do not retroactively change their environment provenance. Raw Matchms artifacts remain private with verified local archive readback.

**OHIF finding:** its unchanged recipe returned Docker exit 0, but dependency installation failed because the build context excludes the required `platform/docs` workspace via `.dockerignore`. Piped commands masked the failure. No controls were run on that unusable image; owned resources are removed. [Diagnosis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7e115ad9dc3ab60d36f1f45e2b1da1b9f9c7ea09/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-reconstruction-diagnosis.md).

**Active:** one unchanged Scanpy recipe reconstruction is running before the timeout controls. Its saved failed pip command remains intact; no dependency repair or model call is added. Job ceiling: 2.667 allocated CPU-hours, charged against the existing 32-hour first-stage bound. [Checkpoint](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/c7408455/experiments/29-runtime-limits/reconstruct_scanpy.py).

**Remaining:** OHIF's four incomplete pairs, Scanpy's 300→1,200-second comparison, then separate OpenMS checkout/MMseqs2 bootstrap investigations. Scanpy reconstruction is a prerequisite: its saved recipe retains an originally failed pip command. No recipe/test repair or extra LLM repair loop is permitted.

**Execution:** first-stage cumulative bound remains 32 allocated CPU-hours on existing reserved capacity, zero model calls. Previously completed Matchms/OHIF containers, images/cache and volumes are verified removed; active Scanpy cleanup is pending. All follow-up work remains research-only.

[Verified Matchms controls](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9e83a0c2781f254f22bea33ecc1d2b2f07669dad/experiments/29-runtime-limits/matchms-control-results.json) · [Control accounting](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9e83a0c2781f254f22bea33ecc1d2b2f07669dad/experiments/29-runtime-limits/controls-accounting.json) · [Reconstruction accounting](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9e83a0c2781f254f22bea33ecc1d2b2f07669dad/experiments/29-runtime-limits/reconstruction-accounting.json) · [Full plan and limitations](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9e83a0c2781f254f22bea33ecc1d2b2f07669dad/experiments/29-runtime-limits/plan.md). Detailed logs remain in comments.

comments.body:
🤖 Initial investigation is published on the permanent research branch at `3588e2b6123b87f58ff3c41a50fe562815160723`.

The input inventory is complete: 14 original controls were unstarted. Fresh paired comparisons require 20 commands across nine existing exports: 16 Matchms/OHIF scheduling controls and four Scanpy timeout-arm controls. Task and reconstruction member hashes are recorded. No tasks have been regenerated or executed.

The two partly completed Matchms/OHIF pairs need both sides on the same reconstructed image; reusing an old nop result with a new-image oracle would confound the comparison. The 300-second and 1,200-second Scanpy arms also require both controls. Original images were deleted, so reconstruction provenance and recipe validation are prerequisites.

Next: inspect saved reconstruction recipes and runner timeout-override support, then checkpoint a bounded live comparison. Proposed first stage is $0 model calls and at most 32 allocated CPU-hours on existing reserved capacity; it has not been submitted. OpenMS checkout and MMseqs2 bootstrap comparisons remain separate later arms.

[Evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/3588e2b6123b87f58ff3c41a50fe562815160723/experiments/29-runtime-limits/plan.md) · [Scope](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/3588e2b6123b87f58ff3c41a50fe562815160723/experiments/29-runtime-limits/issue-scope.md) · [Logbook](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/3588e2b6123b87f58ff3c41a50fe562815160723/experiments/29-runtime-limits/logbook.md). All changes remain research-only; no promotion to main, live task repair or model spend. The issue remains open.

🤖 Reconstruction and timeout prerequisites are now checked, without executing tasks or calling a model.

- All original task/reconstruction hashes are recorded. Matchms, OHIF and Scanpy saved RUN bodies pass `bash -n`; this is syntax evidence only. Scanpy's original smoke/fresh-image flags remain false.
- Exact Harbor 0.6.6 wheel source was verified against its published SHA. `--verifier-timeout-multiplier 4` changes the verifier limit alone from 300 to 1,200 seconds when other overrides are unset. The verifier can retry internally once even with job retries disabled, which is included in the proposed scheduling bound.
- The next step is a checkpointed controls-only runner. There are still zero recovered tasks, remote jobs or model calls in this follow-up.

[Plan](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/cb3e394aa11ff02c03649edb058d9184962bd1ab/experiments/29-runtime-limits/plan.md), [reconstruction readback](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/cb3e394aa11ff02c03649edb058d9184962bd1ab/experiments/29-runtime-limits/reconstruction-readback.json), [Harbor provenance](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/cb3e394aa11ff02c03649edb058d9184962bd1ab/experiments/29-runtime-limits/harbor066-provenance.json).

🤖 Controls-only preparation is now checkpointed: nine unchanged exports, 90 verified files and 20 dry-run Harbor commands. No controls, image builds or model calls have been launched.

The runner reserves two verifier intervals plus 300 seconds per trial, and a separate 300-second cleanup reserve. Each repository's full command set reserves 7,200 seconds; a 9,600-second job therefore leaves at most 2,100 seconds for controller setup, image reconstruction and overhead. It reports unstarted controls if preparation exceeds this allowance and stops after a wrapper timeout so owned containers can be removed.

Original transcript alignment found a stronger Scanpy prerequisite: the saved Dockerfile retains its step 7 pip command, which originally exited 1 with an externally-managed-environment error. This is historical evidence, not a fresh build result. It must not be silently skipped or repaired. OHIF's BASH observations reported zero, although pipelines can mask underlying failures. Raw Matchms task packages remain private.

[Runner](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/e6b740de0f665128925984a4a366d757bd602351/experiments/29-runtime-limits/run_existing_controls.py), [input readback](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/e6b740de0f665128925984a4a366d757bd602351/experiments/29-runtime-limits/control-input-readback.json), [recipe history](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/e6b740de0f665128925984a4a366d757bd602351/experiments/29-runtime-limits/recipe-history-results.json), [plan](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/e6b740de0f665128925984a4a366d757bd602351/experiments/29-runtime-limits/plan.md).

🤖 The eight unchanged Matchms controls completed, and their terminal archive was downloaded and SHA-verified. All four exports (671, 675, 70, 98) have nop=0/oracle=1, every oracle command is clean, and regression tests pass on both sides. Original verifier results were read without regrading; all 40 task-file hashes/modes were preserved.

The unchanged reconstruction recipe installed packages successfully and collected 1,446 tests. Reconstruction used 0.12724778 allocated CPU-hours; controls used 0.30341222, totaling 0.43066 before the small cleanup job. Both jobs had one attempt and zero model calls. Control-owned containers, images and volume are verified removed. The separate cleanup job has also verified that reconstruction-labeled images and containers are absent; downloaded tools were removed.

These results complete missing controls for existing exports. They are not new tasks or an exact replay of the deleted original image: mutable package/base-image versions can differ. Original and reconstructed-environment evidence remain separate. Raw Matchms archives are retained privately rather than published under blanket repository licensing.

[Per-control and paired outcomes](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9e83a0c2781f254f22bea33ecc1d2b2f07669dad/experiments/29-runtime-limits/matchms-control-results.json), [control archive identity and resource accounting](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9e83a0c2781f254f22bea33ecc1d2b2f07669dad/experiments/29-runtime-limits/controls-accounting.json), [reconstruction readback](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9e83a0c2781f254f22bea33ecc1d2b2f07669dad/experiments/29-runtime-limits/reconstruction-readback-001.json).

[Verified image cleanup](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9e83a0c2781f254f22bea33ecc1d2b2f07669dad/experiments/29-runtime-limits/cleanup-result-001.json) and [complete accounting](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9e83a0c2781f254f22bea33ecc1d2b2f07669dad/experiments/29-runtime-limits/campaign-accounting.json): **0.435 allocated CPU-hours including cleanup**, zero model calls, all three jobs terminal.

🤖 OHIF's first unchanged reconstruction produced an image but not a usable environment. Verified logs show `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE` for missing `platform/docs`, followed by missing Jest environment dependencies and zero listed tests. Installation/test-listing pipelines hid failures behind Docker exit 0.

The exact original Git commit contains `platform/docs/package.json`, while its `.dockerignore` excludes `platform/docs/`. Upstream bootstrap uses `docker cp` for the full checkout; generated reconstruction uses filtered `COPY` build context. This identifies a reproducibility mismatch, not proof of an inconsistent original lockfile or verifier-timeout failure. No task controls were run, and no lockfile/package repair was applied.

The original log/archive is verified and retained privately. Reconstruction and cleanup consumed about 0.129 CPU-hours; all labeled images/containers and downloaded tools are removed. All five #29 jobs to date are terminal, totaling about 0.564 CPU-hours and zero model calls. A possible next comparison is generic complete-checkout context fidelity with all recipe commands unchanged; it has not been run.

[Diagnosis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7e115ad9dc3ab60d36f1f45e2b1da1b9f9c7ea09/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-reconstruction-diagnosis.md), [exact source readback](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7e115ad9dc3ab60d36f1f45e2b1da1b9f9c7ea09/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-context-source-readback.json), [archive readback](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7e115ad9dc3ab60d36f1f45e2b1da1b9f9c7ea09/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-reconstruction-readback-001.json), [cleanup](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7e115ad9dc3ab60d36f1f45e2b1da1b9f9c7ea09/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-cleanup-result-001.json), [cumulative accounting](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7e115ad9dc3ab60d36f1f45e2b1da1b9f9c7ea09/experiments/29-runtime-limits/campaign-accounting.json).

🤖 Submitted `/exedev/biotasks29-scanpy-reconstruct-001`, one unchanged saved-recipe reconstruction at source `903925920218f829f3cad4f9f4730c086267ee53`. It is currently running. The originally failed system-pip command remains intact; no skip, repair or model call is added.

The attempt uses existing reserved capacity: 4 allocated CPUs/16GiB, 2,400 seconds total, with the build capped at 1.5CPU/6GiB/1,800 seconds. Its 2.667 allocated CPU-hour hold plus previously measured 0.5637022 remains within the existing 32-hour first-stage bound. Failure is a reconstruction result, not evidence about the verifier timeout; controls start only if a usable baseline is available.

[Submission and input hashes](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/302cbbcb/experiments/29-runtime-limits/scanpy-reconstruction-submission.json). The image, if successfully built, remains owned only for the pending control comparison/cleanup. Failed build resources are cleaned under the exact ownership label. No task files have changed.
